entries.title: Executive, platform team
entries.description: Supporting client-side technology operations on a platform team through Quess Corp — application monitoring, deployment activities and the documentation that goes with them, working alongside the technical teams that own the delivery process.

entries.title: GitOps & Observability Platform
entries.description: A multi-node KIND cluster that reconciles itself from git: Go microservice with Prometheus RED metrics in a minimal non-root image, parameterised Helm chart with ServiceMonitor and an optional HPA, GitHub Actions gating on kubeconform, Helm lint and GHCR publishing, Argo CD with self-healing, and Grafana fed by kube-prometheus-stack plus Loki/Promtail.

entries.title: tenantguard
entries.description: A multi-tenant isolation verifier that synthesises row-level-security policies and diffs captured traffic under them — proving a leak against real PostgreSQL semantics instead of guessing from SQL text. Validated against two real third-party applications, coder and zitadel.

entries.title: Skillsight
entries.description: A curated link aggregator for frontend, design and Claude Code resources: fuzzy search, an in-app viewer that detects when a site refuses to be framed, captured thumbnails, and an admin dashboard with audit logging. Live on Vercel.
